thread:
karim: Heads up — after the runtime merge from yesterday (router + eviction refactor) we've started seeing OOM spikes on longctx workers. Repro in staging: 3/5 longctx pods OOM within 20 mins under steady seq-len 1024 load. Logs attached below.

sophia: :eyes: CI perf tests also flaked on mem usage in the nightly smoke. Seen in alloc profiler?

ci-bot: nightly/inference-stress — build 2026-03-17-22 failed: peak_rss 9.4GB (expected <8GB). See job: https://ci.redwood/inference/2026/1234

alex: throwing a quick pmap from a repro run:
```
PID   RSS
1234  4.8G
1235  3.9G
1236  5.1G
```

karim: profiled heap with jemalloc stats and runtime slab counters. Observations: slab_swap_rate +6x, free_list_frag > 0.35, kv_cache_evictions jumping 10x on seqlen>=1024. Kernel selection path seems to prefer small-kernel route when slab pressure high; suspect the kernel-router heuristics changed allocation alignment and increased fragmentation.

maria: can you paste the small perf snippet and the exact commit range? I'll start a bisect.

karim: commit range: c2f7d1e..b9a3f20 (router + eviction scoring). Repro script: 
```
./scripts/load-test --model redwood/llama-13b --seq 1024 --concurrency 8 --duration 30m
```

maria: starting git bisect locally now.

oncall-eng: rolling-restart scheduled? If this is hitting prod we should freeze rollout for the cluster and revert if necessary.

sophia: it's blocking the staged rollout flag we promoted at 04:00. Recommend rollback until root cause identified. :thumbsup: 

maria: bisect result — b9a3f20 increases slab fragmentation; delta: change to eviction scoring window (window_ms -> dynamic) caused frequent micro-evicts and immediate re-insert churn. Reproducer repros only when seq-len > 768 and with KV cache enabled.

karim: confirmed. Patch suggested: 1) make dynamic window cap 200ms, 2) add seqlen-aware min-window (min-window = max(64ms, seqlen/16 ms)), 3) avoid kernel-route change for small alignments. I'll draft PR.

alex: opened revert PR (PR #4823) to temporarily revert router heuristic while karim's patch is reviewed.

ci-bot: PR #4823 merged to main at 1961234720; automated canary deployment queued.

oncall-eng: canary deployed to us-west-2 longctx pool, start monitoring.

ci-bot: canary health: alloc_rss down to baseline within 6m, no OOMs in 30m window.

sophia: yay. Keep monitoring 24h; leave rollout paused for full cluster until karim's targeted fix lands and e2e perf passes.

karim: working on targeted fix now — will include detailed perf numbers and a regression test to catch seqlen-sensitive cache churn.

maria: note for postmortem: add a small-scale load test for seqlen=1024 into CI perf suite.

oncall-eng: thanks — moving to incident-followup channel for action items.

sophia: closing thread; ping if anything recurs.
